notes: Israel Tax Authority interpretation directive 01/2025: VAT is 18% on every transaction and on imports from 1 Jan 2025; the directive has no gold carve-out and Israel has no investment-gold exemption, so bullion and jewellery are both 18%; silver likewise. Customs duty on gold not quantified on an opened primary page, null. No primary same-day spot, so premiums/buyback null.

sources.name: Israel Tax Authority - Interpretation Directive 01/2025 (VAT rate rise to 18%)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: from 1 Jan 2025 the VAT rate on a transaction in Israel and on the import of goods is 18%
sources.quote: החל מיום 01 בינואר 2025 ישתנה שיעור המע"מ המוטל על עסקה בישראל ועל יבוא טובין מ17% ל-18%
